# Vercel: delete a deployment

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To delete a Vercel deployment, call the DELETE /v13/deployments/{id} endpoint with SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the exact deployment ID and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the required authentication headers. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the exact request body shape and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the exact success status code.

Search intents:
- Vercel delete deployment
- Vercel deployment cleanup
- Vercel deployment delete

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-delete-deployment --json
